body:
Restaurants and other food businesses require a Shopify theme with capabilities that a standard eCommerce store theme may lack.

Choosing the best Shopify theme for your online store is a simple way to get you started.

What are the best Shopify themes for restaurant and cafes?

Before you begin your search, you should first identify which features are important to your online businesses.

The best theme should provide details such as the menu, location, business hours, and an online booking feature.

If you are a startup food company, you can try these free Shopify themes; Narrative, Brooklyn, and Express.

If you are looking for premium themes, Fresh is the best for startups, and Emerge can help you attract more customers.

Here are the 10 best Shopify themes for restaurants, whether you're an entrepreneur or a creative professional looking to take your online store to the next level.

10 Best Shopify Themes for Restaurants

  1. Foodie—Best for small inventory shops
  2. Fresh—Best premium for startups
  3. Vantage—Best for small and large shops
  4. Blockshop—Best for large product imagery
  5. Flow—Best for minimalist design
  6. Providence—Best for eCommerce conversion
  7. Emerge—Best for engaging new audiences
  8. Narrative—Best free for startups
  9. Brooklyn—Best for modern design
  10. Express—Best for mobile

1. Foodie

Foodie is a versatile conversion-focused theme specially designed for smaller inventory shops.

Foodie is the best Shopify theme for restaurants with small inventories.

It's ideal for professional chefs or even foodies who wish to make money by selling their masterpieces.

‍Price: $250.00‍

The Grind from Foodie will provide your online store with a fresh, appealing look that can help you attract more clients.

This theme is the best solution if you want to sell your products while encouraging visitors to visit your physical store.

You can include your contact information at the top of this template to make it easier for your customers to inquire about deliveries.

‍Foodie also supports the sale of things that are only available to people of a certain age, such as lottery tickets, alcohol, and cigarettes.

If you have a physical store and want to extend it through an online store, Foodie is the best Shopify theme to use.

‍Try Foodie Shopify Theme Now

2. Fresh

Fresh is an excellent starting point for food and beverage establishments having three presets and unlimited possibilities.

Fresh is the best premium Shopify theme for startup food business with large inventories.

This is a simple and adaptable theme for food and beverage establishments.

‍Price: $350.00‍

Fresh is a simple and versatile Shopify theme for restaurants, with features that will satisfy your appetite.

With advanced filtering, you can help customers traverse your products and narrow their searches.

This feature allows your customer to sort the products by brand, kind, color, and size.

‍Fresh is specifically made for large inventory food establishments.

If you are looking for the best premium Shopify theme to begin your online food website, Fresh is the ideal choice.

‍Try Fresh Shopify Theme Now

3. Vantage

Vantage (Black) is the best option if you are looking for a website theme that works well with all types of shops.

Vantage is the best Shopify theme that is perfect for small and large catalogs.

This conversion-focused theme allows you to attract and have more engaged customers.

‍Price: $240.00‍

Vantage showcase various product or brand photos on your home page with a slideshow.

On the theme's collection page, users are allowed to filter products by type and sort them by best sellers and prices.

When you click over a product image, the Vantage theme allows you to have a closer look and more product details.

The theme is designed for establishments that handle a high volume of transactions in a given period.

If you are looking for the best Shopify theme that is ideal for small and large inventories, Vantage is a must-try design.

‍Try Vantage Shopify Theme Now

4. Blockshop

Blockshop is a modern, minimalist theme that manages to balance product imagery and persuasive on-site content.

Blockshop is the best Shopify theme with large product imagery for restaurant

The broad layout of the design allows you to showcase large product images on your website.

‍Price: $250.00‍

The Deli template from Blockshop is an excellent choice for food businesses to present their products in a simple and engaging way.

It provides a streamlined shopping experience with a sleek user interface and eye-catching images.

‍Blockshop’s built-in header slideshow, Instagram feed, and homepage video choices boost the visual appeal of your store.

It may miss any unnecessary extra effects, but the product pages are very well designed.

If you are looking for a Shopify theme with large product imagery, Blockshop is the ideal theme for your restaurant website.

‍Try Blockshop Shopify Theme Now

5. Flow

The Flow is worth considering if you're looking for a sleek and simple style that puts your products front and center.

Flow is the best Shopify theme for restaurant website with minimalist design.

This theme is suitable for all types of food and beverage establishments.

‍Price: $350.00‍

The Queenstown from Flow has many features that can make your goods distinctive and increase conversions to your website.

It gives you a lot of options with the number of products you want to show on the collection page rows.

Each page has a lot of room for product pictures, so you can see the products up close from different angles.

The Flow provides you with integrated, fast, “quick shop” drawers, customers can buy as they browse.

If you are looking for a simple Shopify theme to showcase your food products, Flow is the best option.

‍Try Flow Shopify Theme Now

6. Providence

Providence is a conversion-focused Shopify restaurant theme with a clean, minimal design.

Providence is the best Shopify theme that is focused in eCommerce conversion.

The theme’s Birch design is an excellent option for businesses with a medium to big product inventory.

‍Price: $200.00‍

The Birch setup is a great option for food businesses wishing to present products in a clean and organized manner.

Providence's pages are well-designed that clearly state all of the important product information.

A configurable sidebar menu and a quick-buy option are among the theme's sales-boosting features.

The Providence also offers a product image zoom feature that allows visitors to get a closer look at images.

If you are looking for a Shopify theme to boost your sales, Providence can do the tricks for you.

‍Try Providence Shopify Theme Now

7. Emerge

If you are looking for a website theme for your online restaurant business, Emerge-Bright is the ideal option.

Emerge is the best Shopify theme for engaging new audiences.

This is the best way to promote your brand and reach out to new consumers.

‍Price: $250.00‍

Emerge allows your customers to easily add products to their shopping basket without leaving the page they're on.

It includes a multi-level drop-down menu to make it easier for customers to explore your store.

The Emerge theme is ideal both for online and physical establishments.

This website design allows you to display information about your store's location and events to get customers in the door.

If you are looking for the best Shopify theme options for your online restaurant, Emerge should be included in your list.

‍Try Emerge Shopify Theme Now

8. Narrative

If you want something modern and fresh website theme for your next online food business, Narrative is a great choice.

Narrative is the best Shopify theme for startup restaurant business.

This is a great free option for food startups and enterprises with a single product.

‍Free‍

The Narrative's distinctive homepage slider is an appealing approach to promoting new products and variants.

The Warm setting in the theme was created with brands with a story to tell in mind.

This theme is tailored to businesses with small and limited inventories.

The Narrative also comes with additional conversion-boosting elements, such as a fixed navigation bar for a more seamless browsing experience.

If you are looking for a free Shopify theme to start your food business with, Narrative should be on your top list.

‍Try Narrative Shopify Theme Now

9. Brooklyn

If you are looking for a clean, modern, image-focused theme, then Brooklyn is the best website design for you.

Brooklyn is the best Shopify theme for modern design.

The theme’s Playful setting makes it a great choice for food and beverage firms.

‍Free‍

The Brooklyn theme is perfect for those who are wishing to showcase their great products in a bright and energetic way.

Selecting Playful as your theme will draw all of your customers' attention to your products' appealing design.

The design has an uncluttered, spacious, and fresh feel to homepage images, creating a visually pleasant impression.

The sticky right-hand side of every product page is a particularly outstanding example of Brooklyn’s conversion-booster feature.

If you are looking for a free Shopify theme for your food business, this is the perfect time to give it a try for Brooklyn.

‍Try Brooklyn Shopify Theme Now

10. Express

Express (Bistro) is a Shopify restaurant theme that is optimized for mobile devices.

Express is the best mobile-friendly Shopify theme.

This Shopify template was created to help you get online easily and hassle-free.

‍Free‍

Express is a precise way to get your restaurant online with a one-page experience that's easy to manage.

This theme is perfect for stores with small to medium inventories.

Some of the Express' essential features are a collapsible cart drawer, product modals, and a responsive design.

It gives merchants with limited product imagery a professional and clean website appearance.

If you are looking for the most responsive, mobile-friendly theme for your online food business, Express is the best free option.

‍Try Express Shopify Theme Now‍

Conclusions

That wraps up my list of best Shopify themes for restaurants, it's time to choose the right theme for you.

Are Shopify themes good for your food and drinks business?

Your choice of theme will be determined by your brand's distinct image, items, inventory quantity, and business objectives.

These Shopify themes will help you build a strong online presence that will boost your potential.

In my list, Foodie is the best Shopify theme if you are planning to build a food business with small inventories.

Food and beverage website must be fast, easy to navigate, and completely responsive in order to generate sales.

Now that I have provided you this list, which do you believe are the best and must-try Shopify themes for food and drink businesses?
